# status.realm.watch v2 Design Spec

**Date:** 2026-04-07
**Status:** Approved
**Author:** JP + Claude
**Depends on:** Realmwatch Autodiscovery Engine (2026-04-07 spec, in progress)

## Overview

Rewrite status.realm.watch from a shell-script-based static-config monitor into a **Go relay server** that aggregates three data sources (realmwatch, openclaw, cloud provider status feeds) and serves a real-time dashboard via SSE.

No more `checks.json`. No more `check.sh`. The list of what to monitor is auto-discovered by realmwatch's autodiscovery engine. status.realm.watch becomes a pure **display + aggregation layer**.
